children: Overview
Singapore telecom operator's H1 revenue rose yr/yr to S$7.29 bln
Net profit after tax for H1 fell to S$1.55 bln from S$3.41 bln
Earnings per share declined sharply from previous year
Outlook
Singtel raises FY27 OpCo EBIT growth guidance to between mid and high-single digits from low to mid-single digits
Targets around S$3 bln FY27 capital expenditure and expects S$1.1 bln in regional associates' ordinary dividends
Company expects total FY27 dividend to grow by mid to high-single digits, barring unforeseen circumstances
Result Drivers
OPERATING GROWTH – NCS, Optus and Digital InfraCo improved, aided by a stronger Australian dollar and partly offset by Singtel Singapore weakness
REGIONAL ASSOCIATES – Broad-based mobile growth lifted associates' post-tax contributions, though weaker regional currencies created an S$81 mln headwind
PRIOR-YEAR EXCEPTIONAL GAINS – Net profit fell mainly because H1 FY2026 included S$2.21 bln of gains from the Airtel stake sale and Intouch-Gulf merger
FREE CASH FLOW – Higher operating cash flow, increased associate dividends and lower capital expenditure lifted free cash flow
